name: update_action_item
description: Update one or more fields of an existing action item belonging to the current user. Only provided fields are changed; omit a field to leave it unchanged. At least one of title/content_details/priority/target_date must be supplied.

action_item_id.description: The id of the action item to update.

target_date.description: New ISO-8601 datetime, or empty string to clear the deadline.
